overview.description: The Polen 5Perspectives Small-Mid Growth ETF (PCSG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund is an actively managed SMID-cap growth ETF focused on US companies with strong growth potential, competitive positioning, and favorable thematic and cyclical trends. PCSG was launched on May 18, 2026 and is issued by Polen.
